/usr/bin/time isn't available. Let me measure memory with a Python wrapper using resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) right after a single child, or use `tracemalloc` inside... Simplest: run the child and read its peak RSS via resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss in a fresh parent process (so the value isn't polluted).

Let me do that for a single heavy line and for 8 heavy lines.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev/scratch && for f in heavy.jsonl; do python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, sys, resource, time
data = open('/workspace/dev/scratch/heavy.jsonl','rb').read()
for tag, payload in (('1 line', data.split(b'\n')[0]+b'\n'), ('8 lines', data)):
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=payload, capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    r = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%s: rc=%d wall=%.2fs childcpu=%.2fs peakRSS=%.0fMB out=%.1fMB' %
          (tag, p.returncode, t1-t0, r.ru_utime+r.ru_stime, r.ru_maxrss/1024.0, len(p.stdout)/1e6))
PYEOF
done
